features.feature_value: Allowed posts unless they were harmful/threatening to a group/person/identity (e.g., telling someone to die).
features.evidence_span: So long as nothing harmful or threatening towards a group, person, or identity
features.rationale: The participant explicitly sets a harm/threat condition for allowing content.

features.feature_value: Used presence of name calling/cursing/hyperbole as a reason to reject; otherwise allowed.
features.evidence_span: reject anything that resorted to name calling, cursing or hyperbole
features.rationale: They describe a concrete linguistic rule for removal decisions.

features.feature_value: Reluctant to remove posts due to belief in freedom of speech; tended to remove only with lots of language.
features.evidence_span: I was hesitant to remove any posts because I believe everyone has the right to freedom of speech.
features.rationale: The participant foregrounds pro-free-speech motivation and reduced removal likelihood.

features.feature_value: Focused on impartiality and whether posts help debate, but worried emotional tone would undermine responses.
features.evidence_span: I wanted to be impartial... Many of them were good to debate... emotional maturity would undermine the opportunity to hear real response.
features.rationale: They describe evaluating the role of the content in enabling debate rather than matching political versions.

features.feature_value: Attempted to judge whether content was debate-like vs inflammatory; blocked when only emotional invectives appeared.
features.evidence_span: whether this could be part of an actual debate... if it was just inflammatory rhetoric
features.rationale: Their criteria hinge on discourse quality (debate vs inflammatory invective).

features.feature_value: Checked for explicit death threats and sexual content; considered porn as potentially disallowed.
features.evidence_span: consider if the posts made death threats... or were sexual
features.rationale: They mention specific content categories they screened for.

features.feature_value: Generally saw nothing wrong except a couple posts; noted disagreement is not a reason to remove.
features.evidence_span: I dont see anything wrong with them... I may not agree but they are still free to say it
features.rationale: They describe a permissive standard grounded in free expression despite disagreement.
